name: Slack
tagline: Business communication platform with channels, threads, and integrations
verdictSummary: Chat is easy. Real-time sync across devices with offline support, message history, search across millions of messages, and the integration ecosystem — that's the product.
moatNotes: Slack's moat isn't the chat UI — it's that every person in your company uses it and every tool integrates with it
whyPeopleStillPay: Enterprise communication with compliance, integrations, and message retention
notes: For a small team, use Discord or Zulip. For enterprise, Slack or Mattermost.
